purpose: Review a finite issuer mineral-resource estimation, reserve conversion, mine-plan economics, grade and recovery, depletion reconciliation and closure lifecycle domain before source rows, values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.owned_asset_boundary: Campaign178 freezes mine property, plant, equipment, construction and capital expenditure as productive assets. Those balances do not identify geological confidence, ore body, grade, cutoff, contained metal, reserve conversion or depletion reconciliation.
repository_evidence.operating_right_boundary: Campaign179 freezes mining or operating rights, concessions, tenure and quota. A legal right does not establish that an economically mineable resource exists or its reporting-code classification, grade, recovery and reserve inventory.
repository_evidence.operating_kpi_boundary: Campaign168 freezes production, throughput, capacity and utilization KPIs. Output does not reconstruct opening reserves, discoveries, category conversions, model revisions, dilution, losses and closing reserves.
repository_evidence.environmental_boundary: Campaign165 freezes emissions, water, waste, remediation and environmental externalities. Closure and rehabilitation obligations remain adjacent context and cannot substitute for deposit-level resource and reserve estimates.
repository_evidence.pricing_boundary: Campaign169 freezes commercial and commodity pricing states. Spot or forecast prices are economic assumptions in a reserve test, not a mineral inventory or confidence classification.
repository_evidence.sector_boundary: Point-in-time mining, exploration and attributable-project scope must be frozen; non-mining issuers and projects without an applicable mineral estimate remain structurally not applicable and cannot be filled with zero.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current technical report or latest reserve table cannot be projected backward without historical reporting-code, competent-person, drilling, model, cutoff, conversion, production, revision, acquisition, disposal and first-public histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: exploration_drilling_assay_geological_model_and_resource_classification_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known deposit state linking drilling, sampling, assay, geological model and estimation to inferred, indicated and measured mineral-resource categories under a named reporting code and competent person.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time history freezes issuer, project, tenement, deposit, drill program, sample and assay quality, geological model, estimation method, reporting code, competent person, effective date, correction and first-public timing across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: resource_to_reserve_conversion_feasibility_cutoff_and_mine_plan_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known conversion state connecting measured or indicated resources to probable or proven reserves through feasibility, mine design, cutoff, recovery, dilution, commodity-price, cost, permitting and economic assumptions.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete technical-report history connecting resource and reserve basis, modifying factors, feasibility stage, mine plan, cutoff, recovery, dilution, price and cost assumptions, permits, revisions, supersession and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: reserve_inventory_discovery_conversion_acquisition_depletion_and_revision_reconciliation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known reserve roll-forward linking opening inventory to discovery, category upgrade or downgrade, acquisition or disposal, production depletion, processing loss, sterilization, economic revision and closing inventory.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves deposit-level opening and closing resources or reserves, category transfers, ownership changes, mined and processed material, recovery loss, model and economic revisions, failed projects, correction and complete stock-flow reconciliation.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: ore_grade_dilution_recovery_stripping_stockpile_tailings_and_closure_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known ore-quality and recoverability state covering head and reserve grade, dilution, metallurgical recovery, stripping ratio, ore and waste movement, stockpiles, tailings reprocessing, reserve exhaustion, closure and rehabilitation transition.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time history connects comparable ore and contained-metal units to grade, dilution, recovery, strip ratio, stockpile additions and drawdown, tailings recoverability, exhaustion, suspension, closure, rehabilitation, revision and structural not-applicability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: fixed_asset_capex_license_environmental_kpi_commodity_price_land_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing asset, capital-expenditure, license, environmental, production-KPI, commodity-price, land-right or security-price state relabeled as mineral-resource quality or reserve resilience.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Adjacent aggregate states do not identify deposit geology, reporting code, confidence class, grade, cutoff, contained commodity, modifying factors, reserve conversion or an auditable inventory roll-forward.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: reserve_direction_cutoff_grade_equivalent_unit_commodity_region_project_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of resource or reserve tonnage, contained commodity, grade, cutoff, recovery, dilution, strip ratio, mine life, project, commodity, geography or event window.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing more or fewer reserves, high or low grade, a metal-equivalent formula, cutoff, commodity, geography, project stage, successful discoveries only, lag or window before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce project survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_resource_conversion_reserve_reconciliation_and_ore_quality_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer mineral-resource score across exploration classification, resource-to-reserve conversion, reserve roll-forward and ore-quality or recovery states.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted source families or choosing unit normalization, attributable ownership, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before mining scope and every base source contract are complete.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four exploration, reserve-conversion, inventory-reconciliation and ore-quality lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; adjacent-domain relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
